reproduce: pnpm run bench:public --heldout <path to heldout-v1.jsonl> --name-model <model directory>

english.name: rules + name model (experimental)
english.note: rules + name model (experimental): the proxy-default rules plus the nym name model (`rules-6+intl-1+nym-edge-int8-2`, shipped `nameModel` defaults), through the code path the proxy uses for user-written text. Each prompt is one user message; the model reads only its prose lines and skips code, log, config, and data lines by design, so it cannot find names there except by propagation of a value found in prose. Sensitive values inside prose lines, by format: config 4%, chat 99%, code 6%, email 97%, csv 83%, sql 5%, diff 100%, log 34%, stacktrace 35%, markdown 95%, shell 48%. Its latency includes inference

english.name: Presidio 2.2.364 (en_core_web_lg, cutoff 0)
english.note: Presidio: presidio-analyzer 2.2.364, spaCy 3.8.16, en_core_web_lg 3.8.0, the default model; default recognizers; language "en" for every prompt; the cutoff is Presidio's `score_threshold`, below which detections are dropped; latency is analysis only
